objective_method: Compare every test record with controlled configuration fields
required_instrumentation: Configuration manifest and revision reader
acceptance_criteria: All required revisions and hashes are present and match
evidence_required: Completed audit checklist and configuration snapshot

objective_method: Review ownership approval and change-history fields
required_instrumentation: Controlled governance register
acceptance_criteria: Every requirement risk and gate has accountable fields

objective_method: Review qualification evidence for each enabled leg axis
required_instrumentation: Axis qualification dossiers
acceptance_criteria: No axis enabled without complete evidence

objective_method: Review release-gate dependency chain
required_instrumentation: Controlled release records
acceptance_criteria: HR-30D acceptance precedes HR-30W untethered test

objective_method: Review restraint use through released phases
required_instrumentation: Test logs and restraint state records
acceptance_criteria: No untethered run before HR-30W release

objective_method: Review every released operating-boundary artifact
required_instrumentation: Controlled labels manuals and procedures
acceptance_criteria: All artifacts state adult-operated experimental machinery boundary

objective_method: Audit access-control logs during energizable V0 work
required_instrumentation: Entry log and power-state log
acceptance_criteria: Zero child entries while actuator energization is possible

objective_method: Review W0 W1 restraint calibration and axis records
required_instrumentation: Controlled gate dossier
acceptance_criteria: All prerequisites approved before powered stance

objective_method: Review operating authorization after engineering walk test
required_instrumentation: Released operating-boundary record
acceptance_criteria: Walking test does not authorize operation among people

objective_method: Inspect pack architecture and trace exact parts against drawings
required_instrumentation: Calibrated DMM isolation tester and controlled BOM
acceptance_criteria: Pack fuse BMS precharge disconnect telemetry and voltage limits match release

objective_method: Trace protected power domains against ECAD and panel
required_instrumentation: Continuity tester and released drawings
acceptance_criteria: Compute safety and actuator domains are separately protected

objective_method: Inspect each actuator branch protection conductor and connector
required_instrumentation: Milliohm meter thermal camera and calibrated load source
acceptance_criteria: Every branch matches released ratings and derating

objective_method: Measure shoulder datum to maximum object position
required_instrumentation: Calibrated steel rule or CMM
acceptance_criteria: Reach is no greater than 360 mm

objective_method: Exercise each joint to software and hard-stop boundaries
required_instrumentation: Angle reference and clearance gauges
acceptance_criteria: Stops prevent cable shield and pinch contact with released clearance

objective_method: Verify the received FR13-H101K and FR13-S102K broad-face PCD22 interfaces using controlled MV0-FC01 coupon and per-hole records
required_instrumentation: Controlled coupon and hashes received frames identified gauge traceable dimensional instrument and camera
acceptance_criteria: All eight positions on both frames align without force and recorded offsets meet the released tolerance
evidence_required: Completed CSV record raw photographs and dimensional evidence
notes: This is fit evidence only; exact gauge fastener process capability and acceptance tolerance remain SELECTION REQUIRED

objective_method: Verify the selected FR13-S102K 32 x 16 tapped rectangle using controlled MV0-FC02 coupon and per-hole records
required_instrumentation: Controlled coupon and hashes received S102 frame identified M2.5 gauge traceable dimensional instrument and camera
acceptance_criteria: All four selected tapped positions align without force and meet the released dimensional and thread acceptance criteria
evidence_required: Completed CSV record raw photographs and dimensional evidence
notes: Pattern interpretation is controlled but exact gauge thread criteria fastener stack and tolerance remain SELECTION REQUIRED

objective_method: Receive and identify every H101 and S102 kit frame idler fastener and spacer against the controlled kit-content schedule
required_instrumentation: Controlled kit schedule dimensional tools thread gauge camera and received packaging
acceptance_criteria: Every expected item and quantity is present identified undamaged and consistent with released acceptance criteria
evidence_required: Completed receiving CSV photographs and nonconformance record
notes: Fastener grade material coating torque reuse and allocation remain SELECTION REQUIRED

objective_method: Measure neutral-pose datums
required_instrumentation: Calibrated height gauge
acceptance_criteria: Overall height is 740 to 800 mm and nominal target is 762 mm

objective_method: Count active upper-body axes on pedestal
required_instrumentation: Configuration manifest
acceptance_criteria: Exactly 13 active axes and pedestal fixed as released

objective_method: Measure cover radii and probe powered pinch access
required_instrumentation: Radius gauges and selected access probe
acceptance_criteria: Minimum 3 mm edge radius and no normal access to powered pinch points
notes: Probe and guard standard SELECTION REQUIRED

objective_method: Measure fixed shield and exclusion boundary
required_instrumentation: Calibrated tape and guard checklist
acceptance_criteria: Shield installed and 600 mm controlled boundary maintained

objective_method: Review command authority and attempt prohibited AI write paths
required_instrumentation: Source review and bus monitor
acceptance_criteria: No AI or language-model output can write actuator commands or registers

objective_method: Count HR-V0 axes and verify fixed mounting
required_instrumentation: Configuration checklist
acceptance_criteria: Exactly two arm axes one gripper axis and fixed bench mount

objective_method: Count and identify active axes in both legs
required_instrumentation: Configuration manifest
acceptance_criteria: Six specified active axes per leg

objective_method: Apply the released identity rubric to external form
required_instrumentation: Reviewer panel and controlled rubric
acceptance_criteria: Form is clearly robotic under the released rubric

objective_method: Reconcile measured and CAD part-level mass inertia and COM ledger
required_instrumentation: Calibrated scales CAD mass properties and controlled ledger
acceptance_criteria: Every part and assembly reconciles within released uncertainty

objective_method: Run byte-level worst-case segmented-bus traffic and injected faults
required_instrumentation: Bus analyzer timestamped controller and fault injector
acceptance_criteria: Latency jitter utilization and recovery remain within released limits

objective_method: Inject calibration polarity mirrored-joint and hash mismatches
required_instrumentation: Test controller and controlled fault configurations
acceptance_criteria: Every mismatch inhibits drive and latches a recorded fault

objective_method: Command worst-case combined motion through the workspace
required_instrumentation: Motion capture or calibrated position system and controller logs
acceptance_criteria: Measured TCP speed never exceeds 0.15 m/s
notes: TCP datum and implementation SELECTION REQUIRED

objective_method: Command setup motion at all joints
required_instrumentation: Calibrated motion measurement and logs
acceptance_criteria: Motion requires hold-to-run and never exceeds 10 deg/s

objective_method: Attempt invalid stale and mismatched trajectories
required_instrumentation: Controller logs and fault injector
acceptance_criteria: Only versioned trajectories with matching preconditions execute

objective_method: Inject stale duplicate out-of-order and mismatched messages
required_instrumentation: Network or bus fault injector and timestamped logs
acceptance_criteria: Every invalid message is rejected and recorded within released deadline

objective_method: Inspect and measure mains enclosure and protective bonding
required_instrumentation: PE bond tester insulation tester and visual checklist
acceptance_criteria: Tool access separation and released PE resistance withstand and leakage limits pass

objective_method: Inspect and measure HR-30A actuator power source
required_instrumentation: Released schematic DMM and configuration record
acceptance_criteria: Actuator power is tethered extra-low-voltage and no onboard battery is installed

objective_method: Operate the released duty cycle at environmental corners
required_instrumentation: Calibrated chamber temperature and humidity logging
acceptance_criteria: Pass at 18 and 28 deg C in dry noncondensing conditions

objective_method: Inject defined fall precursors and non-fall disturbances
required_instrumentation: Motion capture force plates and synchronized logs
acceptance_criteria: Detection lead time rate and false-positive limits meet released values
evidence_required: Raw data confusion matrix and report
notes: Thresholds and protective response SELECTION REQUIRED

objective_method: Inject communication limit thermal and current faults
required_instrumentation: Fault injector loads sensors and synchronized logs
acceptance_criteria: Each fault produces the released latched response without unexpected motion

objective_method: Measure grip force across allowed object range
required_instrumentation: Calibrated load cell and object gauges
acceptance_criteria: Results characterize min max repeatability and released force limit

objective_method: Run controlled foam-object handoff endurance
required_instrumentation: Qualified fixture object gauge and synchronized logs
acceptance_criteria: At least 99 of 100 succeed with zero unsafe faults
evidence_required: Video logs raw data and report

objective_method: Inject slip backlash and calibration disagreement
required_instrumentation: Output reference encoder load rig and synchronized logs
acceptance_criteria: Every released fault is detected within released threshold and drive is inhibited

objective_method: Measure log rate content and configuration identity
required_instrumentation: Timestamp analyzer and controlled run
acceptance_criteria: All required channels log at 100 Hz or faster with correct hash

objective_method: Weigh complete configured robot
required_instrumentation: Calibrated platform scale
acceptance_criteria: Mass is no greater than 10.0 kg and above 8.0 kg opens margin review

objective_method: Proof-load each primary load path in guarded fixture
required_instrumentation: Calibrated load cell displacement sensors and guard
acceptance_criteria: Survives three times permitted static load without hazardous failure
evidence_required: Raw load data inspection and report
notes: CAD materials and load cases SELECTION REQUIRED

objective_method: Exercise released power architecture under nominal peak and injected source conditions
required_instrumentation: Power analyzer oscilloscope electronic loads and thermal instrumentation
acceptance_criteria: Voltage current temperature and recovery stay within released limits

objective_method: Remove drive energy in every released pose and mode
required_instrumentation: Restrained fixture motion capture force sensors and synchronized logs
acceptance_criteria: Released protective response contains the robot within all pose-specific limits

objective_method: Exercise camera and indication power/fault states
required_instrumentation: Optical sensor camera-state monitor and logs
acceptance_criteria: Visible hardware-driven indication is present whenever recording is possible
evidence_required: State matrix raw logs and report

objective_method: Proof and dynamic-arrest test the full-height restraint
required_instrumentation: Calibrated load cell surrogate mass motion capture and inspection tools
acceptance_criteria: No floor impact and all released force travel and integrity limits pass
evidence_required: Raw force travel video and inspection report

objective_method: Inject each E-stop channel and contactor-feedback fault
required_instrumentation: Oscilloscope contact-state monitor and restrained mechanism
acceptance_criteria: Both paths remove energy and release/reset never commands motion
evidence_required: Raw timing traces and signed report
notes: Exact hardware and timing limits SELECTION REQUIRED

objective_method: Remove heartbeat then restore it before and after reset and ARM
required_instrumentation: Oscilloscope coil monitors and synchronized controller logs
acceptance_criteria: Heartbeat loss removes power within 300 ms and restoration alone never re-energizes either coil
evidence_required: Raw traces fault matrix and signed report

objective_method: Exercise every fault recovery order including stuck reset and stale target
required_instrumentation: Coil monitors bus logger and fault injector
acceptance_criteria: Only cause removal then physical reset then distinct ARM permits a fresh command

objective_method: Verify PNOZ mode reset pulse EDM routing and injected start-loop faults
required_instrumentation: Oscilloscope continuity tester and fault insertion fixture
acceptance_criteria: Configured falling-edge mode and released fault responses match the controlled procedure
notes: Routing and fault exclusions SELECTION REQUIRED

objective_method: Command E-stop during each released walking state
required_instrumentation: Restrained robot motion capture force and power-state logging
acceptance_criteria: Hazardous drive energy is removed within the released response budget

objective_method: Hold bilateral stance with restraint unloaded
required_instrumentation: Two foot-force systems restraint load cell and motion capture
acceptance_criteria: Feet support measured weight for 120 s and restraint has no sustained support

objective_method: Run 100 bilateral weight shifts
required_instrumentation: Foot force IMU joint thermal current and deadline logs
acceptance_criteria: All 100 remain within every released limit

objective_method: Inject planner sensor deadline and supply faults during stance
required_instrumentation: Fault injector restraint and synchronized logs
acceptance_criteria: Each fault produces released response and latched restart-required state

objective_method: Run validated duty cycle at released ambient
required_instrumentation: Calibrated thermocouples thermal camera current logger and timer
acceptance_criteria: Arm cases below 65 C gripper below 60 C and conductor rise below 20 C
evidence_required: Raw temperature current and ambient data
notes: Duty cycle and ambient SELECTION REQUIRED

objective_method: Assess power and fault indicators at distance and lighting limits
required_instrumentation: Lux meter 3 m fixture and controlled state source
acceptance_criteria: Operators correctly distinguish every released state under released lighting criterion

objective_method: Stand untethered on validated surface
required_instrumentation: Motion capture force plates and synchronized logs
acceptance_criteria: Stand for 120 s without support or released-limit violation

objective_method: Start walk 25 m stop and remain standing
required_instrumentation: Measured course motion capture and synchronized logs
acceptance_criteria: Speed remains 0.10 to 0.14 m/s and stop completes within two steps

objective_method: Turn left and right from released gait state
required_instrumentation: Marked course motion capture and logs
acceptance_criteria: Each 90 degree turn completes within five steps without support

objective_method: Accumulate released walking duty
required_instrumentation: Power thermal joint and timing logs
acceptance_criteria: Complete 30 min without any released-limit violation
notes: Thermal and energy limits SELECTION REQUIRED

objective_method: Measure restraint load throughout slack-tether gait
required_instrumentation: Calibrated inline load cell and robot mass record
acceptance_criteria: Tether carries less than 2 percent of robot weight except logged arrests

objective_method: Measure estimator and foot-force update timing
required_instrumentation: Hardware timestamp capture and controller logs
acceptance_criteria: Pelvis updates at least 800 Hz and foot force at least 500 Hz

objective_method: Terminate Linux process during released gait states
required_instrumentation: Independent controller logs restraint and motion capture
acceptance_criteria: Real-time controller continues safe operation or executes released stop
